svg.title: Intracardiac electrograms from a dual-chamber pacemaker
svg.desc: A schematic heart with atrial and ventricular pacing leads and a pulse generator, alongside two intracardiac electrogram traces — an atrial bipolar channel and a ventricular tip unipolar channel — with marker annotations (AS, atrial sensed; VS, ventricular sensed; VP, ventricular paced) and inter-beat intervals in milliseconds over 11 seconds. Illustrative synthetic data.
